title: RNA and DNA extraction from frozen tissue for nanopore sequencing
author: Eric RA Pederson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bj7tkrnn
materials: Spray with ETOH and then RNaseZap® Thermo Scientific Catalog #AM9780 in the fume hood
Make 3 1.5 ml eppendorf tubes for each sample; 1 with sterile water, 1 with 99% ETOH and 1 with RNaseZap® Thermo Scientific Catalog #AM9780

From the Qiagen AllPrep DNA/RNA Mini Kit Qiagen Catalog #80204 Add 1 ml buffer RLT to 10 ul b-mercaptoethanol Each sample requires 600 ul of buffer RLT + b-mercaptoethanol So for example for 6 samples one would need 3.6 ml of the buffer RLT + b-mercaptoethanol mix. Thus, one would need to prepare 4 ml buffer RLT + 40 ul b-mercaptoethanol . b-mercaptoethanol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #M3148-25ML

Materials to take to the basement -80° freezer; - gloves - white warm gloves - dry ice - blades - wipes - forceps - ethanol spray - petri-dishes (tissue type written on the lid) - marker - paper tape - normal ice - tubes with Beads, PBS and HALT Protease and Phosphatase Inhibitor Cocktail Abcam Catalog #78440 on ice

From the Qiagen AllPrep DNA/RNA Mini Kit Qiagen Catalog #80204 Carefully remove the supernatant by pipetting, and transfer it to the AllPrep DNA spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube (supplied). Close the lid gently, and centrifuge for 30 s at ≥ 8000 x g (≥10,000 rpm).

From the NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina NEB Catalog #E7645S (7 ul) Ultra II End prep reaction buffer (NEB, E7647AA) (3 ul) Ultra I End prep Enzyme mix (NEB, E7646AA) (50 ul) cDNA with adapters Total volume of 60 ul
Serapure/Ampure purification using a 1:1 mix ration (60:60)

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare labelled 2 ml low bind tubes containing 4 Zirconium Oxide Beads (2.0 mm RNase Free, 4 mL, Catalog #ZROB20-RNA) each.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 600 μl of RLT buffer and b-mercaptoethanol mixture to the 2.0 ml tubes containing the beads.

steps.title: Tissue Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Retrieve tissue from the -80°C freezer and place on dry ice. In a sterile manner, cut a small piece of tissue (approximately half a pea size) and place it into the labelled 2ml tubes containing beads and RLT mixture on ice. Use ethanol to clean equipment and forceps to handle tissue.

steps.title: Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Secure lids with tape and use a bullet blender to destroy the tissue for 3 minutes at speed setting 8.

steps.title: Lysate Clarification
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 3 minutes at maximum speed.

steps.title: DNA Column Setup
steps.instruction: Label all spin columns and collection tubes. Place the AllPrep DNA spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube; store at room temperature (15–25°C) or 4°C for later DNA purification. Use the flow-through for RNA purification.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume (usually 600 μl) of 70% ethanol to the flow-through from the DNA column and mix well by pipetting. Do not centrifuge.

steps.title: RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 μl of the sample, including any precipitate, to an RNeasy spin column in a 2 ml collection tube. Centrifuge for 15 s at ≥ 8000 x g (≥ 10,000 rpm) and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNeasy spin column membrane using the following sequence:

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μl Buffer RW1, centrifuge for 15 s at ≥ 8000 x g (≥ 10,000 rpm), and discard flow-through.
Add 500 μl Buffer RPE, centrifuge for 15 s at ≥ 8000 x g (≥ 10,000 rpm), and discard flow-through.
Add 500 μl Buffer RPE, centrifuge for 2 min at ≥ 8000 x g (≥ 10,000 rpm), and discard flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Drying and Elution
steps.instruction: Dry the column and elute the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Place the RNeasy spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube and centrifuge at full speed for 1 min.
Place the column in a new 1.5 ml collection tube.
Add 30 μl RNase-free water directly to the membrane and centrifuge for 1 min at ≥ 8000 x g (≥ 10,000 rpm).
If expected yield is > 30 μg, repeat elution with another 30 μl of RNase-free water or the previous eluate.

steps.title: RNA Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Analyze the RNA using TapeStation and NanoDrop. Store in the -80°C freezer for long term or on ice for cDNA synthesis.

steps.title: DNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the AllPrep DNA spin column (ensure ethanol was added to Buffer AW1 and AW2 concentrates before use):

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl Buffer AW1, centrifuge for 15 s at ≥ 8000 x g (10,000 rpm), and discard flow-through.
Add 500 μl Buffer AW2, centrifuge for 2 min at full speed, and discard flow-through.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Place the AllPrep DNA spin column in a new 1.5 ml collection tube. Add 100 μl Buffer EB directly to the membrane, incubate at room temperature (15–25°C) for 1 min, and centrifuge for 1 min at ≥ 8000 x g (10,000 rpm). Repeat the process to elute further DNA.

steps.title: DNA Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Analyze the DNA using TapeStation (genomic) and Qubit. Store in the -20°C or -80°C freezer.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the following reactions using the cDNA-PCR Sequencing kit (SQK-PCS109):

substeps.instruction: Reaction 1 (in 0.2 ml PCR tube): (X μl) 1 ng PolyA+ RNA (or ~50 ng total RNA), (1 μl) 2 μM VN primers (VNP), (1 μl) 10 mM dNTPs, and (9-X μl) RNase-free water (Total 11 μl). Mix by flicking and spin down.

Reaction 2 (in separate 0.2 ml PCR tube): (4 μl) 5x RT buffer, (1 μl) RNase Out, (1 μl) Nuclease-free water, and (2 μl) 10 μM Strand-Switching Primer (SSP) (Total 8 μl). Mix by flicking and spin down.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis Execution
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription:

substeps.instruction: Incubate Reaction 1 at 65°C for 5 minutes, then snap cool on a pre-chilled freezer block.
Add the strand-switching buffer (Reaction 2) to the snap-cooled mRNA, mix by flicking, and spin down.
Incubate at 42°C for 2 minutes.
Add 1 μl of Maxima H minus Reverse Transcriptase (Total volume 20 μl), mix by flicking, and spin down.
Incubate according to the provided protocol.

steps.title: cDNA PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Add adaptors to cDNA using Prime STAR GXL DNA polymerase (Catalog #R050B) and PCR barcoding expansion 96 (Catalog #EXP-PBC096). Mix: (10 μl) 5x Prime STAR GXL buffer, (1 μl) 10 mM KAPA dNTP mix, (1 μl) Prime STAR GXL DNA polymerase, (5 μl) cDNA, and (1 μl) Barcode mix primer.

steps.title: PCR Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the following PCR program:

substeps.instruction: 1 cycle: 98°C for 30 seconds
10 cycles: 98°C for 10 seconds, 64°C for 15 seconds, 68°C for 10 seconds
1 cycle: 68°C for 5 minutes
Hold: 4°C for infinity

steps.title: First Bead Extraction
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product using beads:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8X beads to samples, flick to mix, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Collect DNA-beads with a magnet and discard supernatant.
Wash with 70% ethanol.
Dry at 37°C for 3 minutes.
Elute with 20 μl TE buffer, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Collect DNA-beads with a magnet and collect supernatant into a new tube.

steps.title: Ligation
steps.instruction: Perform ligation using T4 RNA Ligase 2 (750 units, Catalog #M0239L). Mix: (60 μl) purified DNA, (25 μl) Ligation buffer, (10 μl) Ligase, and (5 μl) adaptor mix. Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Ligation Quality Control
steps.instruction: Run Qubit on the ligated product.

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming Mix Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the priming mix using Flow Cell Priming Kit (Catalog #EXP-FLP002) and Flow Cell (R9) (Catalog #FLO-MIN106D):

substeps.instruction: Mix 12 μl DNA library, 37.5 μl Sequencing buffer (SQB), and 25.5 μl Loading Beads (Total 75 μl).
Perform PCR: 20°C for 5 minutes, then 65°C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Second Bead Extraction
steps.instruction: Purify the product using beads:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8X beads to samples, flick to mix, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Collect DNA-beads with a magnet and discard supernatant.
Wash with 70% ethanol.
Dry at 37°C for 3 minutes.
Elute with 20 μl TE buffer, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Collect DNA-beads with a magnet and collect supernatant into a new tube.

steps.title: Reagent Thawing
steps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing Buffer (SQB), Loading Beads (LB), Flush Tether (FLT), and one tube of Flush Buffer (FB) at room temperature, then place on ice.

steps.title: Third Bead Extraction
steps.instruction: Purify the product using beads:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8X beads to samples, flick to mix, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Collect DNA-beads with a magnet and discard supernatant.
Wash with 250 μl SFB.
Dry at 37°C for 3 minutes.
Elute with 15 μl TE buffer, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Collect DNA-beads with a magnet and collect supernatant into a new tube.

steps.title: DNase I Stock Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare DNase I stock solution (Catalog #M0303S):

substeps.instruction: Inject 550 μl RNase-free water into the vial containing 1500 Kunitz units of solid DNase I using a needle and syringe. Mix by inverting (do not vortex).
For long-term storage, aliquot and store at -20°C (up to 9 months) or 2-8°C (up to 6 weeks). Do not refreeze.

steps.title: DNase I Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the RNeasy spin column with DNase I:

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 μl DNase I stock solution with 70 μl Buffer RDD by gently inverting (do not vortex) and centrifuge briefly.
Add the 80 μl DNase I incubation mix directly to the RNeasy spin column membrane and incubate at room temperature (20-30°C) for 15 min.
Add 350 μl Buffer RW1 to the column, centrifuge for 15 s at ≥ 8000 x g (≥ 10,000 rpm), and discard flow-through.

steps.title: Flow Cell Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the nanopore sequencing device:

substeps.instruction: Set centrifuge to 4°C.
Vortex and spin down Sequencing Buffer (SQB) and Flush Buffer (FB), then return to ice.
Spin down Flush Tether (FLT), mix by pipetting, and return to ice.
Open the device lid and slide the priming port cover clockwise to expose the port.
Remove any bubbles from the priming port by drawing back a small volume (a few μl) using a P1000 pipette set to 200 μl, turning the dial to 220-230 μl. Do not remove more than 20-30 μl.

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming
steps.instruction: Prime the flow cell:

substeps.instruction: Add 30 μl of thawed Flush Tether (FLT) to the Flush Buffer (FB) and mix by pipetting.
Load 800 μl of this priming mix into the flow cell via the priming port, avoiding bubbles. Wait 5 minutes.
Lift the SpotON sample port cover and load an additional 200 μl of priming mix into the priming port (not the SpotON port), avoiding bubbles.

steps.title: Library Loading
steps.instruction: Load the cDNA library into the flow cell:

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly mix Loading Beads (LB) by pipetting immediately before use.
In a new tube, prepare the loading mix: 37.5 μl Sequencing Buffer (SQB), 25.5 μl Loading Beads (LB), and 12 μl cDNA library (Total 75 μl).
Mix the prepared library gently by pipetting just prior to loading.
Add 75 μl of the sample to the flow cell via the SpotON sample port in a dropwise fashion, ensuring each drop flows in before adding the next.
Replace the SpotON sample port cover, close the priming port, and replace the MinION lid.
